user.title: Choose Brand
user.description:
Choose the brand to connect: {brands}.

- FordPass: fully supported (SMS code / password login, all features)
- Lincoln Way: fully supported (SMS code login, shares the same cloud encryption system as FordPass)

phone.title: Phone Number Login
phone.description: Enter the registered phone number to receive an SMS code.

code.title: Enter Verification Code
code.description: The code has been sent to {phone}. Enter the 6-digit code.

password.title: Username & Password Login
password.description: Enter the account and password. The password is stored only in the local Home Assistant configuration. Next, open the login link in a browser and paste the authorization code.

b2c.title: Paste Authorization Code

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials have expired. Re-authenticate to continue (the integration and entities will not be removed).

error.bad_phone: Please enter a valid 11-digit phone number
error.bad_username: Please enter a valid 11-digit phone number (username)
error.passcode_failed: Failed to send the verification code. Check that the phone number is registered with FordPass China, or retry later (see log)
error.missing_deps: Missing dependency packages. Confirm they were installed automatically when the integration installed, or retry later (see log)
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check that the verification code is correct (see log)
error.unknown: Unknown error. Check the fordpass_cn entries in the Home Assistant log
error.bad_code: Invalid or expired authorization code. Please log in again in the browser and copy a fresh code.
error.crypto_data_missing: The runtime data pack is missing, so the login link cannot be built. Allow the integration to fetch it online, or place the data pack manually as described in the notification and retry.

abort.already_configured: This phone number is already configured for this brand
abort.reauth_phone_mismatch: The logged-in account differs from the original phone number. Please remove and reconfigure the integration.

data.coordinate_system: Coordinate system (WGS-84: GPS raw coordinates for HA/OSM maps; GCJ-02: GCJ coordinates as-is for AMap/Tencent maps)
data.reset_cmd_fail: Reset vehicle capability blacklist (clear recorded unsupported commands; entities re-created by capability after restart)
